_comment: Temporary-access tokens (spec 5.2). A token unlocks exactly one
followers_only link for a limited time. In V1 this file is fetched by the
browser, so it DEMONSTRATES the flow but does not enforce anything: the
private URLs are already in the profile JSON on the visitor's device.
The dashboard writes tokens to localStorage; those are merged with these.
Both example profiles have a live token, an expired token and an approved
follower, so examples/ can show all four tiers for either of them.

tokens._note: Never expires, unlimited uses, so the docs and README stay true.
Fixed in the past and used up: shows the graceful fallback to public links.
Same demo token for the shopkeeper scenario.
Expired and used up, so the second example shows the same graceful downgrade to public links as the first.

followers._note: An approved client. Used by the 'view as approved follower' demo.
Awaiting the owner's decision in the dashboard.
A wholesale buyer approved by the shopkeeper, so both example profiles can demonstrate the follower tier.
